Thanks Marissa — brief guidance from leadership for calibration:

1) Be conservative on scoring systemic reliability items where there were >1 customer-impact incidents. 0.6–0.7 is appropriate unless mitigations are fully in place.
2) For growth signals (self-serve adoption, inbound leads) prioritize trend and signal quality over single large deals.
3) If you expect a legit disagreement (e.g., score differs by >0.2 from last checkpoint), call it out in the one-line blurb so we can discuss before finalizing.

I'll upload a short note to the doc with a few judgment calls for infra and revenue ops.
